# Pools By Elio

> Family-owned custom gunite pool, spa, water feature, fountain, outdoor living and commercial aquatic construction company based in Nashville, Tennessee. Founded by brothers Jonathan Elio Rodriguez and David Elio Rodriguez, serving Nashville, Franklin, Brentwood and surrounding Middle Tennessee with over 25 years of experience and an in-house construction crew.

## Verified Business Facts
- **Business Name**: Pools By Elio
- **Founders**: Jonathan Elio Rodriguez & David Elio Rodriguez
- **Experience**: 25+ years in custom pool and aquatic construction
- **Headquarters**: 412 Ezell Pike, Nashville, TN 37217
- **Phone**: (615) 568-3154
- **Email**: eliocustompools@live.com
- **Website**: https://poolsbyelio.net
- **Hours**: Monday–Friday 8:00 AM – 6:00 PM; Saturday & evening consultations by appointment
- **Custom Gunite Pool Starting Tier**: $140,000+ (itemized written proposal provided after on-site consultation)
- **Execution Model**: In-house construction crew directed on site by co-founder Jonathan Elio Rodriguez (no subcontractors)
- **Notable Commercial Experience**: Built the lazy river at Sound Waves inside Gaylord Opryland Resort (Nashville, TN), plus pools, swim-up bars and water features for hospitality venues in downtown Nashville
- **Fountain Specialty Site**: http://thehouseoffountains.com/

## Residential & Commercial Service Pages
- [Custom Pools & Spas](https://poolsbyelio.net/pools-and-spas): Inground pools, lap pools, freeform pools, vanishing edges and spas
- [Gunite Pool Construction](https://poolsbyelio.net/gunite-pool-construction): How gunite shells are engineered and built on Middle Tennessee sites
- [Infinity Edge Pools](https://poolsbyelio.net/infinity-edge-pools): Vanishing-edge pool design, catch basins and site requirements
- [Pool Remodeling & Repair](https://poolsbyelio.net/pool-remodeling): Resurfacing, tile and coping, equipment modernization and structural repairs
- [Water Features](https://poolsbyelio.net/water-features): Natural stone waterfalls, grottos, sheer descents, scuppers and deck jets
- [Pool Technology & Automation](https://poolsbyelio.net/technology): Smartphone pool controls, variable-speed pumps and water treatment
- [Backyard Concepts](https://poolsbyelio.net/backyard-concepts): Pool houses, swim-up bars, outdoor kitchens, fire pits and fireplaces
- [Fountains](https://poolsbyelio.net/fountains): Residential estate fountains, lake fountains and commercial water displays
- [Commercial Pool Construction](https://poolsbyelio.net/commercial-pool-construction): Hotel, resort, club and municipal pools
- [Commercial Water Parks](https://poolsbyelio.net/water-parks): Lazy rivers, wave pools, splash pads and commercial attractions
- [Lazy River Construction](https://poolsbyelio.net/lazy-river-construction): Planning, hydraulics and construction of resort and community lazy rivers
